goldens.comment: Cleanup reference uses incorrect alias - should be 'idp-alias-' + i instead of 'alias'.
goldens.reasoning: C1 describes the same issue: the cleanup uses the literal 'alias' instead of 'idp-alias-' + i.

candidates: Test cleanup registers cleanup against literal alias 'alias' instead of dynamically created IDP aliases ('idp-alias-<n>'), so IDPs created by the test may never be removed and can leak state across tests causing flakiness

Login cache stores results per (realm, FetchMode) with a map entry per organizationId searched, which can grow large in realms with many organizations, increasing memory usage and serialization cost without any bounding/eviction logic
